items.title: Execution semantics
items.text: At-least-once execution, task leases, retries after failure, idempotent methods and handlers, and when to use service tasks.

items.title: Waiting for external events
items.text: When to use messages, system-completed user tasks or polling service tasks, with examples and pitfalls.

items.title: Security
items.text: Protecting the API and console, deriving task identity from authentication and choosing safe process variables.

items.title: Changing processes
items.text: Compatible changes, removing elements with running instances and using KindPrefix for incompatible versions.

items.title: Reference architecture
items.text: A Kubernetes service with a dedicated engine database or a shared service database, including tradeoffs.

items.title: Migrating from Camunda 7
items.text: Reusing diagrams and DMN tables, rewriting delegates and expressions, and handling in-flight instances.

items.title: Prometheus metrics
items.text: Queue states, oldest task age, instance states, open user tasks and attempt durations through client_golang.

items.title: API and console authorization
items.text: Resolve user identity and groups from a request instead of taking the task assignee from its body.

items.title: Operations audit log
items.text: Record who retried a task, edited variables or cancelled an instance, and when.

items.title: History retention
items.text: engine.Retention removes old completed and cancelled instances with element/rule history and user tasks.

items.title: Engine hooks
items.text: engine.Hooks provides element events, service call wrappers for tracing, and instance failure callbacks for alerts.

items.title: Supply chain security
items.text: CI vulnerability checks, image SBOM and provenance, and keyless cosign signatures.

items.title: Messages with key correlation
items.text: Receive tasks and intermediate catches wait for messages from HTTP or Go; TTL buffers early responses.

items.title: User task boundary timers
items.text: Escalate overdue work by cancelling a user task and following a different process path.

items.title: Call activity and subprocess boundary events
items.text: Apply a deadline or error route to an entire child process.
items.source: Граничные события у call activity и подпроцесса

items.title: Non-interrupting boundary timers
items.text: Send reminders or notifications without interrupting the activity.

items.title: timeDate timers
items.text: Use an RFC 3339 deadline or a process variable for intermediate and boundary timers.

items.title: timeCycle timers
items.text: Repeating timers for reminders and scheduled starts.

items.title: History partitioning
items.text: Partition bpm_history by time for predictable growth and partition-based cleanup.

items.title: Server load testing
items.text: Multiple service replicas sharing a database, p99 latency and PostgreSQL replica failover.

items.title: Sequential multi-instance
items.text: Repeat tasks, subprocesses or call activities with a count and completion condition.

items.title: Parallel multi-instance
items.text: Concurrent iterations and collection-driven work, such as approval by everyone in a list.

items.title: Compensation
items.text: BPMN saga rollback using compensating tasks.

items.title: Inclusive and event-based gateways
items.text: Conditional multi-branch selection and waiting for the first message or timer.

items.title: Message starts and interruptions
items.text: Start a process from an incoming event or interrupt an activity with a boundary message.

items.title: Camunda 7 generator attributes
items.text: Reuse Camunda 7 diagrams without redrawing them in a Camunda 8 modeler.
